column1: # Flight Radar partition table — carve out a `maps` partition for downloadable map tiles.
# ESPHome's 16MB default gives app0/app1 0x7C0000 (7.75MB) each and leaves almost
# no room for a new partition. Firmware is ~3.2MB
# still leaves ~2x headroom and frees space for the map blob.
# WARNING: partition-table changes cannot be applied via OTA — existing devices
# must flash once over USB. OTA works again afterwards.
# maps: custom data subtype 0x82 (not a filesystem) — single blob
# sequential reads via esp_partition_* (see map_tiles.h). 512KB; real use ~120KB.
# WARNING: keep order. otadata + phy_init = 0x3000 so app0 lands at **0x10000**.
# ESPHome's esp32/post_build.py.script hardcodes the app address to 0x10000 when
# building FLASH_EXTRA_IMAGES. If app0 moves (e.g. nvs before it)
# overlaps sections (exit 2)
# SUCCESS. Always append new partitions at the end — never before app0.
# Name
otadata
phy_init
app0
app1
nvs
maps
